source_evidence: Exact player 'Follow and examine the register' accepts Ysendre's already offered archive consultation. Day334~18:38–18:55 V, Cirren, Mara and Fenar accompany Caul into existing upper east30x20 private archive. Caul retrieves genuine bound Silver Court household volume from north-wall shelf, relevant intact indexed leaves examined together. Exact prepared document from prep/dm-only/ashen-regency-field-operations-dm-only.md @c729a15ff5f0a08a36cfe2359d6a6eaee53541f9, Offered archive consultation ADMIN-QUEST-D334-20261126-01, with LONG ARC G: original recognition entry dated sixth winter before Convergence, literal 'Valenthia, recognized child of the Sanguine Sovereign', old House/counterseal drawn beside entry, matched with existing Silverward copies/marks. Later continuation first winter following court's practical collapse records custody of preserved household records pending lawful succession, not conveyance of present lands. Entry dates concern recognition and stewardship, not birth date, exact age, or modern territorial boundaries. Mara and Cirren compare with actual Silverward/tower documentation; readable name and later custody entry accessible without roll. Observable differing hands; no optional dating/authentication check claimed, no exact birth date, full parental identity/fate, personal name of Sovereign, heart function or lost seat location revealed. Caul acknowledges original stewardship arrangement; this is her genuine acknowledgment of historical document, not present fealty or property handover. Mara requests permission to make accurate copy of relevant two entries and counterseal; Caul freely agrees, ordinary documented copying by Mara/Cirren completed in same elapsed examination, originals stay in Caul's archive, new copies retained by party. No original surrendered or transferred, no fee. Historical existence and recognized dynastic standing of ancient child now explicitly discovered, corroborated institutional seal; present claimant linkage not automatically proved merely by matching name. Caul regards V with heightened interest and asks if V has something from Sovereign personally, e.g. a possession or memory she could recognize; no invented automatic recognition or demanded blood test, no V disclosure or decision yet. No oath, agreement to endorse regency, title, combat, Charm, special powers, treasure, resource expenditure or rest. V next choice. Fixed finite manor personnel remain in established positions, Caul in archive with party; no remote peers informed.
